text.title: New Dependency Risk Checklist — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the new-dependency risk record: the exact package and version with its registry provenance, install hooks and near-name check; named `inputs[]` entries for SPDX `licence`, `transitive_count`, `maintainers`, `last_release`, `alternative` (always including in-house or already-in-tree) and `patch_window`; the dated advisory lookup; the lockfile commit; a structured decision with verdict, fallback and mitigation; the alert recipient who is the owner. Validator in scripts/validate-new-dependency-risk-checklist.py enforces it, including the 12-month, single-maintainer and 20-line rules.

required.field: `name`, exact `version` (no range operator), `ecosystem`, `registry_repository_url`, `readme_repository_url`, `repository_matches`, `near_name` (searched, popular near-name or null), `install_scripts` (declared, hooks with what they run) (r-exact-version-pinned-in-lockfile, r-install-hooks-and-provenance-reviewed)
the person who receives the Dependabot / Renovate / audit alert for this package, `role:handle` (r-upgrade-owner-and-patch-window)

named entries: `licence` (SPDX id), `transitive_count` (integer), `maintainers` (integer), `last_release` (date), `alternative` (list with at least one entry, one named `in-house` or `already-in-tree`), `patch_window` (`critical`, `high` as `Nd`); optional `useful_surface_lines`, `distribution_model` (r-licence-spdx-recorded, r-transitive-footprint-counted, r-maintainer-and-release-recency, r-alternative-considered-including-in-house, r-upgrade-owner-and-patch-window)
`source` (osv.dev | github-advisory-database | nvd), `url` for the exact name and version, `checked_on`, `open_advisories[]` ids (r-advisory-query-in-evidence)
`file` (package-lock.json, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Cargo.lock, go.sum), `commit_url` (r-exact-version-pinned-in-lockfile)

`verdict` (accept | accept-with-mitigation | reject | in-house), `statement` naming `name@version`; `fallback` (vendor | fork | alternative) when maintainers is 1 or the last release is over 12 months old; `mitigation` (advisory id + action) for accept-with-mitigation; `distribution_model` for a copyleft licence; `override_reason` when the useful surface is 20 lines or fewer and the verdict is not in-house; `install_hook_reason` when a hook fetches or runs a remote binary
at least two: the advisory lookup URL and the lockfile commit or PR URL (r-advisory-query-in-evidence, r-exact-version-pinned-in-lockfile)
`tool` (dependabot | renovate | npm-audit | pip-audit | cargo-audit) and `recipient` equal to `owner` (r-upgrade-owner-and-patch-window)

forbidden.pattern: `licence` of `unknown`, `see repo`, `MIT-ish` or empty, or a copyleft licence with no `decision.distribution_model` — fm-copyleft-discovered-late
`transitive_count` 0 on a package whose lockfile diff adds more than one package; an advisory URL naming only the direct package while the subtree is non-empty — fm-transitive-blind-spot
`maintainers` 1 or `last_release` older than 12 months with no `decision.fallback` — fm-abandoned-upstream

`near_name.popular_near_name` set, `repository_matches: false`, or an install hook that fetches a remote binary, with a verdict other than `reject` and no `install_hook_reason` — fm-typosquat-or-install-hook
`useful_surface_lines` 20 or fewer with a verdict other than `in-house` and no `override_reason` — fm-trivial-utility-adopted
`open_advisories[]` non-empty with verdict `accept`, or `accept-with-mitigation` whose `mitigation.advisory_id` is not in the list — r-advisory-query-in-evidence
`alert_routing.recipient` different from `owner`, or `patch_window` missing `critical` or `high` — r-upgrade-owner-and-patch-window

list.item: `licence` is an SPDX identifier from package metadata, cross-checked against the LICENSE file; a copyleft licence names its `distribution_model` in the decision (r-licence-spdx-recorded).
`transitive_count` comes from a dry-run install and the decision covers the whole subtree (r-transitive-footprint-counted).
`maintainers` and `last_release` are recorded; one maintainer or a release older than 12 months forces `decision.fallback` (r-maintainer-and-release-recency).
`advisory_lookup.url` is for the exact name and version, dated today; an open advisory forces `reject` or `accept-with-mitigation` naming it (r-advisory-query-in-evidence).
`alternative` lists at least one option and always `in-house` or `already-in-tree`; a surface of 20 lines or fewer defaults to `in-house` (r-alternative-considered-including-in-house).
`package.version` is exact and `lockfile.commit_url` points at the lockfile change (r-exact-version-pinned-in-lockfile).
Install hooks are listed with what they run, `repository_matches` is true, and `near_name.popular_near_name` is null (r-install-hooks-and-provenance-reviewed).
